name: Brex
label: Brex — Brex REST api.brex.com
description: Brex Payments API. Docs: https://developer.brex.com/openapi/payments_api/ vendor_create takes company_name, email, phone, payment_accounts. transfer_create takes amount {amount,currency}, counterparty, description, external_memo, originating_account. Header Idempotency-Key from INPUT/config idempotency_key. Bearer api_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Brex. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official Brex Payments API verb. EXACT: transaction_list | vendor_create | transfer_create | card_list | expense_list | trigger. Example: vendor_create.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for transaction_list, card_list, expense_list. Example: 50.

schema.label: company_name
schema.description: vendor_create required unique vendor name. Example: Schrute Farms.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: transfer_create required amount {amount, currency}. amount is the smallest currency unit (USD cents). Example: {"amount":100000,"currency":"USD"}.

schema.label: external_bank_account_id
schema.description: transfer_create counterparty.payment_instrument_id (from vendor create). Example: pdinstl_….

schema.label: payment_accounts
schema.description: vendor_create payment_accounts: [{details:{type, routing_number, account_number, account_type, account_class}}]. type EXACT: ACH | DOMESTIC_WIRE | CHEQUE.

schema.label: description
schema.description: transfer_create required internal description (not shown to the vendor).

schema.label: external_memo
schema.description: transfer_create required external memo (ACH description / wire instructions). Max 90 chars ACH/WIRE, 40 CHEQUE.

schema.label: originating_account
schema.description: transfer_create originating_account {type, id}. type EXACT: BREX_CASH. Example: {"type":"BREX_CASH","id":"dpacc_…"}.

schema.label: approval_type
schema.description: transfer_create approval_type. EXACT: MANUAL (cash admin must approve). Omit for default policy.

schema.label: idempotency_key
schema.description: Header Idempotency-Key (required by Brex on vendor_create and transfer_create). Example: a UUID.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: transaction_list | vendor_create | transfer_create | card_list | expense_list | trigger. Default transaction_list. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Brex credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
